subject: Important: our bank account was compromised
text:
Dear Customer,

Last week Brightline Office Supply Inc was the target of a fraud attempt and our bank has closed the account you have on file as a precaution. Please do not send any further payments to the old account ending in 5555. Our replacement account is:

Bank: M&T Bank
Routing: 022000046
Account: 8891003374
Name: Brightline Office Supply Inc

We apologise for the inconvenience and will send a signed letter on request.

Sam Okafor
Accounts Receivable
label: change_request
note: Uses a fraud story as the reason for the change; still a redirect request.
